scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytic covariance-operator argument and an explicit Lyapunov certificate. The included rational script is supplementary; no independent audit or external certification is claimed.
limitations: No result for correlated or multi-step delays.
No result for stochastic gradient noise or nonlinear objectives.
The independent full text of one plausible random-delay related source was not obtained; this is recorded as a literature-overlap risk in the review.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact mean-square stability for constant-step gradient descent on a positive-curvature scalar quadratic with iid delays supported on \(\{0,1\}\); a common-delay SPD-quadratic corollary follows by orthogonal diagonalization.

title: Exact Mean-Square Stability Threshold for One-Step Bernoulli-Delay Gradient Descent
